sections.heading: About this site
sections.text: Velo is a static, independent showcase. It does not sell bikes or user data.

sections.heading: Information you provide
sections.text: Information is collected only when you choose to enter it in the contact form. When a form endpoint is configured, the form sends its fields to that endpoint. Without one, it opens your email app so you can send the message.

sections.heading: Local preferences
sections.text: The site stores your comparison selections and specification display preference in local browser storage. These values stay in your browser and can be cleared there.

sections.heading: External links
sections.text: Bike brands and other sources link to websites operated by others. Their privacy practices are separate from Velo.

sections.heading: Changes and questions
sections.text: This placeholder notice may be updated as the site changes. Contact Velo to ask about privacy or request a correction.

sections.heading: An independent showcase
sections.text: Velo is an independent reference site. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the brands named here, and it does not sell bikes.

sections.heading: Information on this site
sections.text: Specifications, availability and indicative prices are provided for comparison and may change. Check the linked brand or source before making a decision.

sections.heading: Brand names and images
sections.text: Brand names identify products. Product names, images and other marks belong to their respective owners; image credits are shown where available.

sections.heading: External websites
sections.text: Links to brand pages and sources are provided for reference. Velo does not control those websites or their content.

sections.heading: Corrections
sections.text: If you find an error or believe material needs attention, contact Velo with the relevant page and details.

sections.heading: Placeholder notice
sections.text: This plain-language summary is a placeholder, not legal advice. It should be reviewed before publication.
